name: Arix Energix Limited
about: Arix Energix Limited operates as a web-infomedia company in India. The company operates through four segments: Web based Solution and Software Development, MagZine & Information Media, Exhibition Management Services, and Investments services. It operates JimTrade.com, a business-to-business (B2B) directory with a database of product profiles listed under various product categories; JimSMEnews.com, an SME news portal; and JimYellowpages.com, an online yellow-page directory that offers information about Indian business organizations and companies along with their details, such as contacts, products, and services. The company also offers IndiaNetzone.com, an encyclopedia of India with articles providing information on arts, entertainment, health, sports, society, travel, and other areas related to India. The company was formerly known as Jupiter Infomedia Limited and change its name to Arix Energix Limited in July 2026. Arix Energix Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Mumbai, India. As of March 23, 2026, Arix Energix Limited operates as a subsidiary of Arix Capital Limited.
